From 0972252450f90db56dd5415a20e2aec21a08d036 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Arun Easi <aeasi@marvell.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Mar 2022 01:25:56 -0800
Subject: [PATCH] scsi: qla2xxx: Fix crash during module load unload test

During purex packet handling the driver was incorrectly freeing a
pre-allocated structure. Fix this by skipping that entry.

System crashed with the following stack during a module unload test.

Call Trace:
	sbitmap_init_node+0x7f/0x1e0
	sbitmap_queue_init_node+0x24/0x150
	blk_mq_init_bitmaps+0x3d/0xa0
	blk_mq_init_tags+0x68/0x90
	blk_mq_alloc_map_and_rqs+0x44/0x120
	blk_mq_alloc_set_map_and_rqs+0x63/0x150
	blk_mq_alloc_tag_set+0x11b/0x230
	scsi_add_host_with_dma.cold+0x3f/0x245
	qla2x00_probe_one+0xd5a/0x1b80 [qla2xxx]

Call Trace with slub_debug and debug kernel:
	kasan_report_invalid_free+0x50/0x80
	__kasan_slab_free+0x137/0x150
	slab_free_freelist_hook+0xc6/0x190
	kfree+0xe8/0x2e0
	qla2x00_free_device+0x3bb/0x5d0 [qla2xxx]
	qla2x00_remove_one+0x668/0xcf0 [qla2xxx]

Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20220310092604.22950-6-njavali@marvell.com
Fixes: 62e9dd177732 ("scsi: qla2xxx: Change in PUREX to handle FPIN ELS requests")
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Reported-by: Marco Patalano <mpatalan@redhat.com>
Tested-by: Marco Patalano <mpatalan@redhat.com>
Reviewed-by: Himanshu Madhani <himanshu.madhani@oracle.com>
Signed-off-by: Arun Easi <aeasi@marvell.com>
Signed-off-by: Nilesh Javali <njavali@marvell.com>
Signed-off-by: Martin K. Petersen <martin.petersen@oracle.com>

diff --git a/drivers/scsi/qla2xxx/qla_os.c b/drivers/scsi/qla2xxx/qla_os.c
index 58c83525f006..9c4f2b38b34e 100644
--- a/drivers/scsi/qla2xxx/qla_os.c
+++ b/drivers/scsi/qla2xxx/qla_os.c
@@ -3901,6 +3901,8 @@ qla24xx_free_purex_list(struct purex_list *list)
 	spin_lock_irqsave(&list->lock, flags);
 	list_for_each_entry_safe(item, next, &list->head, list) {
 		list_del(&item->list);
+		if (item == &item->vha->default_item)
+			continue;
 		kfree(item);
 	}
 	spin_unlock_irqrestore(&list->lock, flags);
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/scsi/qla2xxx/qla_os.c`**
   - A conditional check was added in the `qla24xx_free_purex_list` function to skip freeing a specific pre-allocated structure. The check ensures that if the current item being processed is the `default_item` associated with the `vha` structure, it will not be freed. This prevents a crash that occurred during module unload tests.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in `qla_os.c` directly addresses a bug that caused a crash during the module load/unload test. The crash was linked to the incorrect freeing of a pre-allocated structure, which was identified in the call trace provided in the patch description. By adding the conditional check to skip freeing this specific structure, the patch resolves the issue, ensuring that the driver can handle purex packet processing without leading to a crash. This change is a fix for the previously introduced change referenced in the `Fixes` tag, which indicates that the issue arose from a prior modification in the codebase.

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the driver incorrectly freeing a pre-allocated structure during the handling of purex packets. Specifically, the structure associated with the `default_item` was being freed, which led to a crash during module unload tests. This occurred because the code did not account for this specific structure, resulting in an invalid memory operation.

Here is the patch:
 
 static inline void
 qla24xx_free_purex_list(struct purex_list *list)
 {
 	struct purex_item *item, *next;
 	ulong flags;
 
 	spin_lock_irqsave(&list->lock, flags);
 	list_for_each_entry_safe(item, next, &list->head, list) {
 		list_del(&item->list);
+		if (item == &item->vha->default_item)
+			continue;
 		kfree(item);
 	}
 	spin_unlock_irqrestore(&list->lock, flags);
 }
